name: voice-mode
description: Hear Claude talk. One-off text-to-speech on demand, plus an opt-in auto-speak mode (Stop hook) that reads every reply aloud — session-scoped so only one window speaks. Free Microsoft neural voices via edge-tts (no API key; text is sent to Microsoft's Edge read-aloud service), English + Polish auto-detect, silent playback through ffplay, mpv, mpg123 or afplay.
